## Install

This component does not have a registry template yet.

Install the primitive package instead:

```bash
pnpm add @zeus-web/avatar
```

## Imports

Styled registry component:

Not available yet.

Primitive React wrapper:

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@zeus-web/avatar/react'
```

Web Component entry:

```ts
import '@zeus-web/avatar/wc/auto'
```

## Props

| Prop    | Type                                          | Default  | Description   |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------- |
| `size`  | `AvatarSize`<br />Values: `sm`, `md`, `lg`    | `md`     | Avatar size.  |
| `shape` | `AvatarShape`<br />Values: `circle`, `square` | `circle` | Avatar shape. |

## Events

| Event         | React prop     | Detail               | Description                              |
| ------------- | -------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `image-load`  | `onImageLoad`  | `nativeEvent: Event` | Emitted when avatar image loads.         |
| `image-error` | `onImageError` | `nativeEvent: Event` | Emitted when avatar image fails to load. |

## Slots

| Slot      | Description                              |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `default` | AvatarImage and AvatarFallback children. |

## Styling

Uses Tailwind: yes

Theme tokens:

- `bg-muted`

Internal selectors:

- `[data-slot=avatar-root]`
- `[data-slot=avatar-image]`
- `[data-slot=avatar-fallback]`

## Registry

Registry source: not available yet.

The `avatar` primitive is available through `@zeus-web/avatar`, but it is not currently installable through the CLI registry.

Use the primitive package directly until a registry template is added.

## AI usage rules

Do:

- Use AvatarImage with meaningful alt text.
- Always provide AvatarFallback.

Do not:

- Do not use Avatar for decorative icons.
- Do not omit fallback content.

## Examples

### React styled usage

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@zeus-web/avatar/react'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Avatar>
      <AvatarImage src="/avatar.png" alt="User" />
      <AvatarFallback>ZW</AvatarFallback>
    </Avatar>
  )
}
```
